data.body:
[P1] Release checkpoint draining when the deadline passes

If a checkpoint request is pending when this fires, `terminate()` blocks new enqueues and aborts step signals, but the wrapper still awaits `waitForQueueCompletion()` before handling the deadline. A stalled request delays `InvocationDeadlineError` and cleanup; `processQueue()` also sends updates queued behind it. For deadline termination, abandon unsent updates and release the wrapper's wait without resuming operation callers, while preserving ordinary fault draining. Add a held-request regression that expects the deadline error before releasing the checkpoint.
